items.name: pos_18-061_fig05_v1.jpg
items.reply:
The part has a fatigue crack that initiated at the lower side of a doubler or spar cap near a rivet hole and propagated through the structure.

From the reports:
- The photo shows a fatigue failure on a spar component, with damage near a rivet hole labeled LC-1 and LD-1, matching the fracture surfaces shown in figures 5 and 10. [18-061 fig05]
- Fatigue origins were located at the lower surface of the spar cap both forward and aft of hole LC-1 and at the aft side of hole LD-1. [18-061 p2]
- In the doublers, fatigue origins were noted on the lower sides of the doublers both forward and aft of the attachment holes. [18-061 p3]

What to do:
- Do not use this part; it is unsafe due to fatigue cracking. (inferred)

Closest report figures: 18-061 fig05 (0.78), 18-061 fig10 (0.66), 18-061 fig15 (0.65)
